gloss: close call; narrow escape; by a hair's breadth

definitions.gloss: close call; narrow escape; critical moment
definitions.explanation: A dangerous situation where disaster was barely avoided.

examples.japanese: {危機一髪|ききいっぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{免|まぬか}れた→免れる：10548_manugareru⟧。
⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{危機一髪|ききいっぱつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}った→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: I made the train by a hair's breadth.

examples.japanese: {危機一髪|ききいっぱつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{落下物|らっかぶつ}→落下物：22008_rakkabutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|よ}けた→避ける：14848_yokeru⟧。
examples.english: I dodged the falling object just in time.

notes:
STRUCTURE (YOJIJUKUGO):
⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧ (crisis) + {一髪|いっぱつ} (one hair)
Literal: "crisis of one hair" - the margin was as thin as a single hair

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {危機一髪|ききいっぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (just barely, at the last moment)
- {危機一髪|ききいっぱつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{助|たす}かる→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧ (be saved by a hair)
- {危機一髪|ききいっぱつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逃|のが}れる→逃れる：10425_nogareru⟧ (escape by a hair)

TRIVIA:
The phrase emphasizes how close the danger was - separated by the width of a single hair.

SIMILAR:
- ⟦{間一髪|かんいっぱつ}→間一髪：15872_kanippatsu⟧ - very close in meaning; {危機一髪|ききいっぱつ} names the crisis, ⟦{間一髪|かんいっぱつ}→間一髪：15872_kanippatsu⟧ names the margin
- ⟦{九死|きゅうし}に{一生|いっしょう}→九死に一生：18016_kyuushiniisshou⟧ - narrow escape from death, used for far graver danger
